design: The round-1 reviews showed that reading the new rows while an older tab can write only the lists changes behaviour. D2 is therefore the expand step of 03 §3.1's two-release rule: the lists stay the copy the app reads, every save writes the changed items beside them in one transaction, a repair on open keeps the rows identical to the lists, and reads move to the rows (with the repair retired or turned round) once no older app can write the lists. The plan's wording 'read and written item by item' became 'written item by item beside the lists' (04 D2, 03 §3).
